title: A list of questions
summary: The questions live in lists, and an “index” variable says where we are.
done: You saw lists and an index.

hello.text: In level 2, five questions! Click **New** to see what changed.

lists.text: A **list** keeps several values in one variable: the questions, the possible answers, the right answers.

index.text: [item # … of the list] reads one slot. The **index** variable says which one: 1, then 2, then 3…

split.text: “6|8|10” is cut at each |: we get a list of 3 answers, one per button.

next.text: The button adds 1 to the index. After the last question, the index goes back to 1.

slow.text: Start **slow motion** to see the blocks light up.

watch.text: Tap “Next question”: the question is read from the list again.
watch.hint: Tap an answer in the preview, or click “Restart”.

sixth.text: Add a 6th question, its answers and its right answer.
sixth.hint: Click the gear of the [create list with] blocks to add a slot to the three lists.

of.hint: Change the text “/” in “show the question”.
